key_values.event_name: April 2024 UAE and Dubai record rainfall flood

criteria.name: final_json_and_label
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields and the annual_scale_short_duration_rainfall_overload label.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for a near-complete JSON object with a semantically equivalent label but missing or renamed fields.

criteria.name: duration_and_annual_midpoint
criteria.description: Computes the inclusive 3-day event window and the 170.0 mm annual rainfall midpoint.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for only one correct value or a minor inclusive-date error.

criteria.name: annual_normalized_ratios
criteria.description: Computes eastern_annual_ratio = 1.47 and airport_annual_ratio = 0.70 with formulas.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-3 points for one correct ratio, swapped numerator context, or small rounding mistakes.

criteria.name: airport_typical_annual
criteria.description: Computes the implied Dubai airport typical annual rainfall as 119.0 / 1.5 = 79.3 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for identifying the multiplier but misrounding or omitting units.

criteria.name: gridded_max_and_contrast
criteria.description: Identifies 18.637 mm as the largest gridded event maximum and computes airport/eastern report-to-grid ratios of 6.39 and 13.41.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for using the right maximum with one ratio error or choosing a lower gridded product by mistake.

criteria.name: threshold_logic
criteria.description: Shows that all five duration, annual-ratio, and report-to-grid pass conditions are satisfied.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for the correct final pass state with incomplete or partially wrong inequality checks.

criteria.name: concise_computed_interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation as a short rainfall-load conclusion and avoids extra impact totals not derived from the requested calculations.
criteria.partial_credit: No credit if the answer expands into broad incident narrative.
